reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggregates recorded session token usage and presents daily and model-level activity through a 365-day heatmap and usage view.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中汇总已记录的会话 Token 用量，并通过年度热力图和模型明细展示每日使用情况。
summaries.en: Aggregates recorded DeepSeek Harness session token usage and presents daily activity through a 365-day heatmap with model-level details.

capabilities: Reads recorded DeepSeek Harness session usage data
Aggregates token counts by day and model
Displays a 365-day token usage heatmap and usage details
Backfills historical session data and reports progress
